structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters

law.catch_line: Unlawful to threaten or hinder surveyor; rights of surveyor; penalty
law.text: It is unlawful for any person to threaten, resist, or in any manner interfere with a surveyor in the performance of duties relating to oyster grounds. The surveyor shall have the right to enter upon any person's lands in the performance of his duties. A violation of this section is a Class 3 misdemeanor.
